entryPointReview: Rework adds two source parity corrections within the reviewed helper/caller boundary. Both moat messages use the literal source string and consume no display RNG; only lava calls hliquid. After awaiting the full helper, zap_map returns immediately if the actual default fatal path set gameover, before learnwand or later caller tail. The tests use real zap_map, canonical drawbridge creation, actual hallucination state/RNG and real end-of-game processing. No C gameplay, public parity or certification is claimed.

functions.name: destroy_drawbridge
functions.sourceReview: Retains the reviewed full C dbridge.c:destroy_drawbridge order. Corrected both visible moat arms to use literal `moat`; hliquid is now called only for lava, preserving its display RNG. The selected zap_map caller now returns immediately after awaited helper completion when actual gameover is set, while lifesaving that clears gameover continues to caller learning/return behavior. Existing scatter, late occupant capture, RNG, terrain and fatal ordering are retained.

callers.source: Real exported zap_map lateral WAN_STRIKING/SPE_FORCE_BOLT, find_drawbridge canonical position and originalType!=DRAWBRIDGE_UP branch. Primary actual initialized target test calls this production entry, not helper-only destroy; no public wand acquisition/history requirement.
